description: Studio portrait of Georgia O'Keeffe's younger sisters, Anita Natalie O'Keeffe (1891-1985) (left) and Ida Ten Eyck O'Keeffe (1889-1961) (right), taken in Sun Prairie, Wisconsin.
imageCaption: H. L. Conrad. Ida (left) and Anita (right) O'Keeffe, ca. 1898. cabinet card. Claudia O'Keeffe Papers. Georgia O'Keeffe Museum.
title: Ida (left) and Anita (right) O'Keeffe
